scheme_name: Central Sector Scheme of National Fellowship for Providing Fellowship to Scheduled Caste Students to Pursue M.Phil. & PhD
description:
The Central Sector Scheme of National Fellowship for Providing Fellowship to Scheduled Caste Students to Pursue M.Phil. & PhD was launched in 2006 by the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of India.

This scheme aims to provide financial assistance to Scheduled Caste students who wish to pursue higher education in the form of M.Phil. and PhD degrees.

The primary objective of this fellowship is to enhance the participation of Scheduled Caste students in higher education and research.

The scheme seeks to empower these students by providing them with the necessary financial support to pursue advanced studies.

The fellowship covers a total of 1,000 slots each year for eligible Scheduled Caste students.

The financial assistance includes a monthly stipend of ₹28,000 for M.Phil. students and ₹31,000 for PhD students.

In addition to the monthly stipend, the fellowship also provides a contingency grant of ₹10,000 per annum for M.Phil. students and ₹20,000 per annum for PhD students.

The fellowship duration is for a maximum of five years for PhD students and two years for M.Phil. students.

The eligibility criteria for this fellowship include being a citizen of India and belonging to a Scheduled Caste category as per the Government of India’s list.

Candidates must have secured admission to a recognized university or institution for pursuing M.Phil. or PhD.

The applicants must have obtained at least 55% marks in their post-graduation degree or equivalent grade.

For candidates belonging to the Scheduled Caste category, there is a relaxation of 5% in the minimum marks required.

The application process for the fellowship is conducted online through the National Fellowship Portal.

Candidates must register on the portal and fill out the application form with accurate details.

Required documents include a caste certificate issued by a competent authority, proof of admission to the M.Phil. or PhD program, and academic certificates.

The application must also include a research proposal outlining the intended area of research.

The deadline for submitting applications is typically set annually and is announced on the official website.

Once the applications are submitted, they are reviewed by a committee that assesses the eligibility and merit of the candidates.

The selection process is based on the academic performance of the candidates and the quality of their research proposals.

Successful candidates are notified through the portal and are required to complete the necessary formalities to receive the fellowship.

The disbursement of the fellowship amount is done through direct bank transfers to the accounts of the selected candidates.

The fellowship is renewed annually based on the satisfactory progress of the candidates in their research work.

The implementing authority for this scheme is the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment.

The National Fellowship for Scheduled Caste Students is administered by the University Grants Commission.

The UGC is responsible for the implementation and monitoring of the fellowship scheme.

The contact details for the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment can be found on their official website.

The scheme has been instrumental in increasing the number of Scheduled Caste students pursuing higher education.

According to reports, the fellowship has significantly improved the enrollment rates of Scheduled Caste students in M.Phil. and PhD programs.

The scheme also aims to promote research and innovation among Scheduled Caste students.

By providing financial support, the government hopes to reduce the economic barriers faced by these students.

The fellowship is part of a broader initiative to enhance educational opportunities for marginalized communities in India.

In recent years, the government has emphasized the importance of research in higher education.

The National Fellowship for Scheduled Caste Students is aligned with the government’s vision of inclusive education.

The scheme also encourages interdisciplinary research and collaboration among scholars.

The fellowship has contributed to the development of a more diverse academic community in Indian universities.

The government regularly reviews the scheme to ensure its effectiveness and relevance.

Feedback from beneficiaries is taken into account for improving the implementation of the fellowship.

The scheme is part of a larger framework of welfare measures aimed at uplifting Scheduled Castes in India.

The government has allocated significant funds for the continuation and expansion of this fellowship scheme.

In the financial year 2022-2023, the budget allocation for this scheme was approximately ₹200 crore.

The fellowship has also been recognized for its role in promoting social justice and equality in education.

The government encourages educational institutions to create a supportive environment for Scheduled Caste students.

Awareness campaigns are conducted to inform potential beneficiaries about the fellowship and its benefits.

The scheme has been successful in fostering a culture of research among Scheduled Caste students.

The government aims to increase the number of fellowships awarded each year based on the growing demand.

The National Fellowship for Scheduled Caste Students is a crucial step towards achieving educational equity in India.

The scheme has received positive feedback from educational institutions and students alike.

The government remains committed to ensuring that no deserving student is left behind due to financial constraints.

The fellowship is a testament to the government's dedication to empowering marginalized communities through education.

The impact of this scheme can be seen in the increasing number of Scheduled Caste scholars contributing to academia and research.

The government continues to monitor the progress of the fellowship and make necessary adjustments to enhance its effectiveness.

The Central Sector Scheme of National Fellowship for Providing Fellowship to Scheduled Caste Students to Pursue M.Phil. & PhD is a vital initiative in promoting higher education among Scheduled Castes in India.
